title: Introduction to msigdbr
text: msigdbr() function returns data frame one gene--gene-set mapping per row. Generally, gene_symbol (gene symbol) gs_name (gene set name) columns relevant. data frame contains following columns gene-level info: gene_symbol Official gene symbol requested species. ncbi_gene NCBI (formerly Entrez) ID requested species. ensembl_gene Ensembl ID requested species. db_gene_symbol Official gene symbol MSigDB database. db_ncbi_gene NCBI ID MSigDB database. db_ensembl_gene Ensembl ID MSigDB database. source_gene Gene identifier original publication. ortholog_taxon_id taxon ID species. ortholog_sources databases support ortholog mapping. num_ortholog_sources number databases support ortholog mapping. gs_* columns provide details gene sets: gs_id Gene set systematic name. gs_name Gene set standard name. gs_collection collection gene set belongs . gs_subcollection sub-collection gene set belongs . gs_collection_name name collection. gs_description description gene set. gs_source_species species gene set originated . gs_pmid PubMed ID. gs_geoid GEO ID. gs_exact_source original source gene set, resource identifier, figure, supplementary document publication. gs_url URL original source gene set. db_* columns provide details MSigDB database identical entire data frame: db_version version MSigDB database. db_target_species target species MSigDB database (HS MM).
code: unique(all_gene_sets$db_version) #> [1] "2026.1.Hs"

code: msigdbr_t2g <- dplyr::distinct(msigdbr_df, gs_name, ncbi_gene) enricher(gene = gene_ids_vector, TERM2GENE = msigdbr_t2g, ...) msigdbr_t2g <- dplyr::distinct(msigdbr_df, gs_name, gene_symbol) enricher(gene = gene_symbols_vector, TERM2GENE = msigdbr_t2g, ...) msigdbr_list <- split(x = msigdbr_df$gene_symbol, f = msigdbr_df$gs_name) fgsea(pathways = msigdbr_list, ...) msigdbr_list <- split(x = msigdbr_df$gene_symbol, f = msigdbr_df$gs_name) gsvapar <- gsvaParam(geneSets = msigdbr_list, ...) gsva(gsvapar) msigdbr_list <- split(x = msigdbr_df$gene_symbol, f = msigdbr_df$gs_name) gsva(gset.idx.list = msigdbr_list, ...)
